title: Street banners
slide_intent: Test recognition at street scale, because viewers encounter a museum identity while moving and from below.
strategic_value: Repeating the vertical signature on narrow suspended banners can connect street encounters with MoMA’s printed communications.
demonstration: Overlapping hanging banners project from a building. A large MoMA signature on the rear banner sits beside a front composition of yellow objects, plus signs and a right-edge signature.
practical_value: Check whether a narrow format can retain both the institution’s signature and a legible exhibition image sequence.

content_islands.name: Rear signature banner
content_islands.spec: Keep the large black MoMA lettering visible behind and to the left of the front banner.

content_islands.name: Exhibition banner
content_islands.spec: Place the vertical object sequence and plus signs in the front banner, beside its right-edge MoMA signature and exhibition details.

content_islands.name: Street context
content_islands.spec: Retain the façade, support rods and low viewing angle to show installation and scale.

reference_purposes.Application: The photograph shows suspended exterior banners viewed from the street.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying caption connects vertical logo placement with the museum’s façade signage.
